thought: Hard constraints are all satisfied. The biggest structural issue is workload imbalance: Stefaan and Nguyen are far over max_total (and several nurses exceed max_weekends), while optimal_coverage_cost is also high. Adding shifts via coverage_fill would likely worsen total_assignment_cost and weekend/consecutive penalties. Best next is to redistribute existing assignments from overworked nurses to others while preserving coverage and skills.

strategy.reason: Block reassign can move multiple duties off the most over-assigned nurses (notably Stefaan and Nguyen) to reduce large max_total violations and may simultaneously relieve some consecutive/weekend pressure without reducing coverage.
strategy.avoid: Avoid coverage_fill or any move that increases total assignments for already over-max nurses or increases working weekends for Patrick/Sara/Nguyen.
